prompt: Turn this list into a balanced recommendation for a neighborhood reading room: 'Open late twice a week. Quiet corner needed. A noticeboard might help. Too few volunteers for every evening. Trial for one month before deciding.' Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text: The neighborhood reading room should trial extended opening hours for one month, staying open late on two evenings each week. This would improve access without placing unrealistic demands on the limited volunteer team. A designated quiet corner should be created for readers who need a calm space, while a noticeboard could promote local events, share updates, and attract additional volunteers. At the end of the trial, feedback from visitors and volunteers should guide whether the schedule and facilities become permanent.
